author: GameTrailers
description: Three loves. One week. Merry Crisis is an intimate, character-driven romance visual novel about love, loss, and belonging—is home what you left behind, or where you're headed? Watch the latest Merry Crisis for this upcoming game ahead of its launch on PC. A demo for Merry Crisis is out now on Steam.
title: Merry Crisis - Official Demo Trailer | Southeast Asian Games Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Traverse a chaotic and crumbling realm of dreams composed of liminal spaces. Adapt to the world’s odd rules as a Dreamer, and defy others like you to escape the strange and eclectic subconscious landscape. Take a look at gameplay and more from Memoirium in this trailer for the upcoming action Souls-like game. Memoirium will be available on PC on August 13, 2026. A demo is out now on Steam.
title: Memoirium - Official Release Date Trailer | Southeast Asian Games Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Get another look at Lost & Found in this trailer for the upcoming adventure mystery game where you return townsfolk’s lost belongings & uncover personal stories behind each item. It features a hybrid animation style that blends 2D, 3D, pixel art, & more. Gather clues, investigate locals, & ensure every lost belonging ends up in the right hands. Lost & Found will be available on PC.
title: Lost & Found - Official Gameplay Trailer | Southeast Asian Games Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Prep your stations for a cozy cooking game with attitude! Get a fresh look at gameplay from KuloNiku: Bowl Up! in this trailer for the upcoming game. Prepare unique meals for quirky small-town locals, upgrade and customize your shop, compete in thrilling cooking battles to become top chef, and protect your family’s long-running restaurant alongside a cast of curious companions!
title: KuloNiku: Bowl Up! - Official Gameplay Trailer | Southeast Asian Games Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at gameplay from Late Night Duty in this trailer for the upcoming short, linear narrative-driven psychological horror walking simulator set in Malaysia. Play as a traumatized veteran on his first night as a school security guard, where routine patrols quickly reveal that something is wrong within the school. Late Night Duty will be available on PC. A demo is out now on Steam.
title: Late Night Duty - Official Demo Trailer | Southeast Asian Games Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at gameplay from Kooeh: A Timeless Delight in this trailer for the upcoming heartwarming, cozy narrative-driven restaurant management game about rediscovering lost family recipes and reviving the family restaurant. Kooeh: A Timeless Delight will be available on PC.
title: Kooeh: A Timeless Delight - Official Gameplay Trailer | Southeast Asian Games Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Hear me, pitiful mortals, for I shall reveal to you the path to true power - a demonic fusion of deckbuilding, ritual duels, and roguelite! I speak of a realm shrouded in darkness, where only the most wicked may thrive. Behold my masterpiece, "Just A Shadow Game." Check out the creepy Just A Shadow Game trailer to see gameplay and more. Just A Shadow Game will be available on PC.
title: Just A Shadow Game - Official Demo Trailer | Southeast Asian Games Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: See the features coming to version 1.0 of The Scroll of Taiwu: Beyond the Dome in this latest trailer for the strategy adventure RPG. The Scroll of Taiwu: Beyond the Dome will be available on June 17, 2026.
title: The Scroll of Taiwu: Beyond the Dome - Official Version 1.0 Preview Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Demo Launch Trailer for Abashed, an adventure narrative-driven puzzle game developed by Supantha Paul. Players will explore the mind of Issac to solve puzzles, sift through the parts of his past, and uncover the truth of a missing partner. Abashed is coming soon to PC (Steam), with a demo available now on Steam.
title: Abashed - Official Demo Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Launch Trailer for Pay 2 Win: The World is Mine, a combo-based incremental strategy game developed by Patriots Division. Players will seek items, cast spells, and decide the definitive fate of the studio through crazy builds. Run up the numbers in Pay 2 Win: The World is Mine, available now for PC (Steam).
title: Pay 2 Win: The World is Mine - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Reveal Trailer for Slayblade, a battle-top action roguelite game developed by Henry's House and Oscar Brittain. Players will collect parts, merge abilities, and take on opponents in battle-top engagements to acquire upgrades. Make cold hard cash and win the city in Slayblade, coming soon to PC (Steam), with a demo available now on Steam.
title: Slayblade - Official Reveal Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Solarpunk is available now on PC (via Steam, Epic Games Store, and GOG), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, and Nintendo Switch 2. Watch the Solarpunk launch trailer for this peaceful survival adventure game.

Set high above the clouds in a vibrant world of floating islands, Solarpunk invites you to build a peaceful life powered entirely by renewable energy. From tending gardens and crafting gadgets to constructing airships and exploring the skies with friends, Solarpunk blends relaxing creativity with light survival mechanics in a truly uplifting adventure.
title: Solarpunk - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the New Demo Launch Trailer for Trickshotterz, a 2D arcade fighting platformer game developed by Lumari Games. Players will take to the stage to pull off insane trick shots against four other players. Attain power-ups and become the best trickshotter in Trickshotterz, coming soon to PC (Steam), with a new demo available now.
title: Trickshotterz - Official New Demo Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Launch Trailer for NBA The Run, a fast-paced 3v3 street basketball game developed by Play by Play Studios. Players will take on other teams across iconic streetball courts around the world. Make strategic plays, go head-to-head with the NBA's biggest players, and rule the court one game at a time. NBA The Run is available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: NBA The Run - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the 18 vs. 18 Bounty Annihilation Game Mode Trailer for Marvel Rivals, the hit team-based action multiplayer game developed by NetEase Games. Players will be able to duke it out in 36-player lobbies in one arena with no restrictions whatsoever. Stack your favorite heroes and revel in the madness in 18 vs. 18 Bounty Annihilation for Marvel Rivals, launching on June 12 for PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: Marvel Rivals - Official 18 vs. 18 Bounty Annihilation Game Mode Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Announcement Trailer for Kingdom Hearts Collection , a new collection of the iconic action-adventure RPG series developed by Square Enix. Players can gain access to an incredible value for the franchise, consisting of KINGDOM HEARTS HD 1.5+2.5 ReMIX, KINGDOM HEARTS HD 2.8 Final Chapter Prologue, and KINGDOM HEARTS III + Re Mind (DLC). The Kingdom Hearts Collection is launching on October 8 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Xbox on PC).
title: Kingdom Hearts Collection [1-3] - Official Announcement Trailer | Nintendo Direct June 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: In this new multiplayer action game, you’ll take on the role of the Bloodsworn and fight against – and alongside – up to seven other players with unique weapons and abilities. Transcend humanity with blood-based powers that transform your character and combat style as you battle to secure the coveted First Blood. The Duskbloods launches exclusively on Nintendo Switch 2 in 2026. Players can learn more about the closed network test for the game, coming in summer 2026!
title: The Duskbloods - Official Closed Network Test Trailer | Nintendo Direct June 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Survive, Exorcise, Change the game. Watch the Jujutsu Kaisen Rumble: Survivaton announcement trailer for this upcoming survivors royale where you battle cursed spirits and rivals, growing stronger throughout the match. Outscore your rivals and fight to be the last player standing victorious. Jujutsu Kaisen Rumble: Survivaton will be available on Steam, Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Xbox Series X|S in 2026.
title: Jujutsu Kaisen Rumble: Survivaton - Official Announcement Trailer | Nintendo Direct June 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Nintendo Switch 2 Trailer for Stellar Blade, the hit third-person action game developed by Shift Up. Unravel the mysteries of Earth's downfall in Stellar Blade, coming to Nintendo Switch in 2026.
title: Stellar Blade - Official Nintendo Switch 2 Trailer | Nintendo Direct June 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Release Date Trailer for Bel's Fanfare, a bullet hell exploration RPG developed by Chibig. Players will explore and solve puzzles across the Witch of the Sea. Take on hostile enemies, make key decisions, and embark on a grand adventure. Bel's Fanfare is launching in 2027 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, and PC (Steam).
title: Bel's Fanfare - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Players can take a look at the K'un-Lun: Shenloong Arena Map Reveal Trailer for Marvel Rivals, the hit third-person action multiplayer game developed by NetEase Games. Players will fight in the legendary Tournament of the Heavenly Cities in the new K'un-Lun: Shenloong Arena. Traverse the map's lush environments and vibrant colors to become a legend. K'un-Lun: Shenloong Arena Map is launching with Season 8.5 of Marvel Rivals on June 12 for PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: Marvel Rivals - Official K'un-Lun: Shenloong Arena Map Reveal Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Season 8.5 Dev Vision Vol. 18 for Marvel Rivals, the hit team-based action game developed by NetEase Games. Players can get the rundown on new changes, a brand-new map, the newest hero Cyclops, and so much more. Season 8.5 for Marvel Rivals kicks off on June 12 for PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: Marvel Rivals - Official Season 8.5 Dev Overview

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Cyclops Character Reveal Trailer for Marvel Rivals, the hit team-based free-to-play action game developed by NetEase Games. Players will embody the founding member and leader of the X-Men, a new Duelist being added to the roster. Lay down damage with his specialized ruby quartz visor to dish out channeled force through his eyes as the ultimate protector of Mutantkind. Catch Cyclops in action on Marvel Rivals, launching with Season 8.5 on June 12 for PlayStation 4 (PS4), PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).
title: Marvel Rivals - Official Cyclops Character Reveal Trailer

description:
Are you ready to fight for the throne? Watch the Metaphor: ReFantazio Nintendo Switch 2 announce trailer for this turn-based RPG. Metaphor: ReFantazio will be available on Nintendo Switch 2 on November 12, 2026.

#IGN #SummerOfGaming #NintendoDirect

description: Reawaken the past, savor the present. Watch the Atelier Karia: The Night Kingdom & the Guide of Memories announcement trailer for this upcoming vast fantasy alchemy RPG of memories and discovery. Atelier Karia: The Night Kingdom & the Guide of Memories will be available on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Nintendo Switch 2, Xbox Series X/S, and Steam in early 2027.
title: Atelier Karia: The Night Kingdom & the Guide of Memories - Official Reveal Trailer | Nintendo Direct

author: GameTrailers
description:
Get another look at Observer: System Redux in this latest trailer for the first‑person cyberpunk horror detective story set in a decaying, neon‑scarred future. As an Observer who invades minds to hunt for clues, you will sift through corrupted memories to track down a mysterious killer and confront your own dark past. The Nintendo Switch 2 version of Observer: System Redux supports the mouse feature of the Joy-Con 2 controllers, as well as optional motion controls. Observer: System Redux will be available on Nintendo Switch 2 on June 18, 2026.

#IGN #SummerOfGaming #NintendoDirect
title: Observer: System Redux - Official Nintendo Switch 2 Trailer | Nintendo Direct June 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
Everbloom is a cute and cozy social farming sim set in a world of whimsy - grow buckets of popcorn right on the plant and make chocolate milk by feeding your cows candy bars. Grow, care, build, decorate, and explore the world of Everbloom solo or with your friends. Watch the latest Everbloom release window trailer for another look at its cozy world and more. Everbloom will be available on Nintendo Switch 2 and PC in spring 2027.

#IGN #SummerOfGaming #NintendoDirect
title: Everbloom - Official Release Window Trailer | Nintendo Direct June 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the latest GigaBash trailer for the ultimate Kaiju Fighting Game for 1-4 players, where you battle as film-inspired Kaijus and giant Heroes in fully destructible cityscapes. The new trailer gives us a look at what to expect with the Ultraman Zero DLC, available on PC (Steam, Stove, and Epic Games Store), PlayStation 5 (PS5), PlayStation 4 (PS4), Xbox Series X/S, Xbox One, and Nintendo Switch on July 9, 2026 (20:00 PDT).
title: GigaBash - Official Ultraman Zero DLC Release Date Trailer | Southeast Asian Games Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Join a member of the development team at Skrollcat Studio for a closer look at Hoa 2 in this trailer for the upcoming 3D platformer adventure game. Hoa 2 will transport you to a beautiful world. Explore, interact with nature, solve puzzles and seek to bring life back to a special friend. Hoa 2 will be available on Steam, Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Xbox Series X/S in fall 2026.
title: Hoa 2 - Official Developer Overview Trailer | Southeast Asian Games Showcase 2026

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the latest Jurassic World Evolution 3 trailer to see what's coming with the Rebirth expansion for the dinosaur park management sim. Delve into a game expanding narrative inspired by the dramatic events of Jurassic World Rebirth. Take control of three top-secret locations, and come face-to-face with four new dinosaurs, including the terrifying Distortus rex! Jurassic World Evolution 3 is available now on PC, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Xbox Series X|S. The Jurassic World Evolution 3: Rebirth expansion will be available on June 16, 2026.
title: Jurassic World Evolution 3: Rebirth Expansion - Official Announce Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Voidling Bound is available now on PC (Steam and Epic Games Store). Check out the Voidling Bound launch trailer for this sci-fi 3rd-person shooter. Step into the sci-fi world in this launch trailer for Voidling Bound, and get ready to become a Space Wrangler and take direct control of creatures called "Voidlings." Shape them through branching evolution paths and upgrade their abilities to overcome bubonic swarms, pestilent bosses, and reclaim lush planets overrun by corruption.

Defenseless against a devastating parasite threatening all life forms, humanity must team up with recently discovered Voidlings to unlock their full potential through the neural bond. Become bound as one, as the last line of defence in our fight for survival.
title: Voidling Bound - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the gameplay trailer for Sojourn Past, the debut bullet-hell action adventure from India-based developers ReDimension Games! Explore an intricately connected handcrafted world, put your skills to the ultimate test in duels that will test your movement as well as your aggression, earn abilities to gain the upper hand in exploration and combat and uncover mysteries and secrets in the world. 

Sojourn Past is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Sojourn Past - Official Gameplay Trailer
